repository_discipline.rationale: The plan is Contract-first, config-first, owner-layer, backend-isolated, evidence-bounded, and preserves the dirty worktree.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: The nominal Hydra profile owns the Reward and privileged preflight owns admission; shared G1 mode code remains a legacy capability, not active FADA authority.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: The plan changes composed configuration and one existing validator surface without adding a wrapper, registry or schema.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Privileged config inherits the nominal profile and adds only runtime, privilege and Gain; nominal config never depends on FADA runtime.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: No new mutable state is introduced; disabled gait-clock reset/step behavior is verification-only.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The retired active profile/validator are replaced at the existing Pinch Points; generic consumers are preserved rather than broadly deleted.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: S0/S1/S3 evidence is separated from formal runtime, simulation, training and policy quality.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: RED composition/preflight tests precede production edits, followed by affected regressions, static checks and final R2 review.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Actor 98-D, state66/previous-action29/command3 and privileged Critic tail are explicit preserved obligations.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Reward selection changes at config admission only; learner, optimizer, return and replay code are untouched.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Checkpoint schema and 20+1 lineage are preserved and covered by existing S3 tests.

dimensions.name: removal-reachability
dimensions.evidence: Repository search identifies the active dual profile, validator, runtime import, unit tests and formal spec; historical evidence remains historical.
